opportunity.title: Short-Form Video Content Creation Package
opportunity.target_customer: Small business owners and emerging content creators
opportunity.customer_problem: Struggling to create engaging short-form video content for platforms like TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts, leading to low visibility and customer engagement.
opportunity.proposed_solution: Provide a tailored video content creation package that includes scriptwriting, caption crafting, and social media strategy to boost online presence and engagement.
deliverables: Five 30-60 second video scripts tailor-made for the customer's brand
Five sets of catchy captions for each video
A 1-page social media strategy guide including posting schedule and content themes
Basic video editing tips for easy implementation
opportunity.next_action: Create a service listing on a freelance platform or personal website
